record_scope_reconstruction: Four phases concern selective freight access to three road crossings, with two separate Dorohusk episodes. Checkpoint references identify affected routes, not exact inland protest barriers.

source_checks.finding: Transport ministry names the three road protests begun November6 and suspended January16; suspension until March1 was planned, not independent evidence of later reopening.
Road authority places Korczowa protest on truck approach, with A4 mainline unaffected and humanitarian/live-animal exemptions.
Interior ministry reports December11 14:00 Kyiv resumption at Dorohusk after first blockade.
December18 report identifies renewed Dorohusk truck blockade several kilometres from checkpoint, with directional quotas and exemptions.

Named road border station, not railway. Secondary page country/category metadata inconsistent; paired road identity supported by original Polish road-authority notice. Exact truck-approach blockade is outside the checkpoint and unlocated.
Named paired road checkpoint on E372, distinct from separate rail station. Reference may fall on Ukrainian facility side; Polish approach blockade not located.
Named road border station rather than rail crossing. Exact Polish protest location several kilometres away is not represented; inconsistent page regional categorization not used as authority.
